product_from_film: Asimov presents a network collecting first-person recordings of everyday human tasks for robot learning.
explains_well: A montage of skilled hand movements makes the variety of useful human activity easy to grasp.
unclear: The film does not show the recording equipment, an accepted submission or how a contributor gets paid.
scenario: Record ordinary cleaning, cooking and organizing tasks as movement data.
product_clear_basis: The presenter describes building a movement dataset from first-person recordings of real tasks.

lessons.keep: Use varied close-up actions to make an abstract data need understandable.
lessons.avoid: Avoid promising earnings before showing what a valid contribution involves.
lessons.open: Capture method, dataset provenance and scale, quality review, income terms and all heard audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, show the raw customer input beside the useful output it helps create.
Explain participation with one real submission, acceptance criteria and an observable result.
